messages:
jordan_revops: AtlasHealth execs requested a 9am PT bridge tomorrow. POC blocked by: routing consent (EU->US egress) and KMS-induced embedding latency. Who can own each?
sara_sales: I'll coordinate & join bridge. Need written one-pager for legal by 6pm PT.
devon_se: I9ll own routing note. What exactly do we need to state?
jordan_revops: customer legal wants a simple dataflow diagram + statement that EU payloads won't be persisted in EU.
anna_eng: KMS issue: looks like per-embed DEK fetches. They do ~350 embed calls/session. We can cache DEK per-session and batch lookups. Need SRE approval for config change.
marco_sre: session DEK cache doable as a canary. We'll limit scope with RBAC and short TTL. Ops can run canary tonight.
sara_sales: customer will want rollback plan and risk note. Tessa, can legal sign off?
tessa_legal: I can review the one-pager. Please include: endpoints, data retention statement, and the limited-risk canary description.
devon_se: egress IPs for one-pager: 34.198.12.0/24, 18.205.33.0/24 (us-east). Adding small diagram.
ops-bot:calendar: Bridge scheduled: "AtlasHealth exec bridge" 2026-05-12 09:00 PT.
anna_eng: timeline: by 18:00 PT share docs; tonight SRE can deploy canary DEK cache; 08:30 PT internal dry-run; 09:00 PT exec bridge.
marco_sre: adding canary config to infra (internal link). Will collect p95/p99 and KMS counts post-canary.
jordan_revops: please drop final docs here by 18:00 PT so I can forward to AtlasHealth legal. Thanks team.
